run_lm_harness_eval: run lm-eval harness evaluation on a consolidated LLM checkpoint with specified tasks
run_validation_eval: run validation evaluation on JSONL data sources and compute NLL metrics per source
run_eval_cli: run the eval CLI with a config file and optional dot-list overrides for EvalArgs
create_eval_harness_lm: create an EvalHarnessLM wrapper around a PackedCausalTransformerGenerator for lm-eval compatibility
consolidate_and_load_checkpoint: consolidate distributed checkpoints and load the model and tokenizer for evaluation
